title: Epidemiology, Population Health and Public Health
description: Introduction to principles and methods of epidemiology particularly as they apply to population health. Measurements of disease occurrence, study designs (cohort, case-control, randomized clinical trials), surveillance systems, population health, public health information systems for infectious and chronic diseases, health promotion and disease prevention issues.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HINF 381, HINF 380, HLTH 254, HLTH 480 (if taken in the same topic).

items.text: admission to BSc in Health Information Science or Combined BSc in Health Information Science and Computer Science
